steps.title: The console shows functions
steps.text: Each call returns a function, so the console lists functions, not numbers: `ƒ fn()` and `ƒ sum()`. The running total hides in a closure.
steps.textZh: 每次调用都返回一个函数，所以控制台列出的是函数而不是数字：`ƒ fn()` 和 `ƒ sum()`。累计的总数藏在闭包里。

steps.title: Ask for the number
steps.text: Both versions give the function its own `toString`, which returns the total. `String(fn)` calls it.
steps.textZh: 两个版本都给函数加了自己的 `toString`，返回累计的总数。`String(fn)` 会调用它。
steps.actionLabelZh: 用 String() 转换两条调用链

steps.title: Coercion with +
steps.text: `+` asks the function for a plain value. `valueOf` gives back the function itself, so JavaScript tries `toString` next, which returns the number `6`.
steps.textZh: `+` 会向函数要一个原始值。`valueOf` 返回的是函数本身，于是 JavaScript 接着尝试 `toString`，它返回数字 `6`。

steps.title: Strings join instead
steps.titleZh: 遇到字符串就变成拼接
steps.text: With a string in the chain, `+` joins text: the total starts at `0`, so `'1'` and `2` give `'012'`.
steps.textZh: 调用链里一旦有字符串，`+` 就会拼接文本：总数从 `0` 开始，所以 `'1'` 和 `2` 得到 `'012'`。
steps.actionLabel: Put a string in the chain
steps.actionLabelZh: 在调用链里放一个字符串
